title: Bluetti launches ‘e-generator’ to take on noisy, stinky, polluting gas generators
description: Bluetti doesn't want you to call the Pioneer 5000 a solar generator (SoGen), even though that's what it is. What makes it slightly different from other large power stations that can be charged off solar - aka, a SoGen - is the dolly cart and up to 18KW of instant surge power available to start […]
